parsed.title: Replace fragile string sentinel parsing with first-class connection_count field
parsed.body: The original code checked tunnel connectivity using string pattern matching (e.g., `connections.starts_with("no ")`), which is brittle and scattered across multiple code paths. Introduced an explicit `connection_count: usize` field to TunnelInfo, enabling type-safe comparisons (`connection_count > 0`). This elevates connection status to a first-class data concern, centralizes the interpretation logic, and eliminates the risk of subtle bugs from string parsing inconsistencies.

parsed.title: Fix tunnel restart loop by correcting launchd KeepAlive behavior
parsed.body: KeepAlive with SuccessfulExit=false prevented launchd from respawning cloudflared after graceful SIGTERM (exit 0), leaving tunnels in a loaded-but-not-running state (pid: None). Changed to unconditional KeepAlive=true to ensure launchd always respawns. The heal command was extended to detect and restart tunnels stuck in this state, which would otherwise remain inactive until manual intervention or the next scheduled heal cycle.

parsed.title: Defensive API integration: multi-layer guards against incomplete or unreachable data
parsed.body: The heal command syncs tunnel status from CloudFlare's API, which may be unreachable or return incomplete data. Multiple defensive checks were added: bail if tunnel_info is empty, skip unreached accounts, and default to healthy status when data is missing (unwrap_or(true)). This layered defensive approach prevents false-positive restart decisions triggered by transient API failures, ensuring the heal loop only acts on confirmed unhealthy tunnels.
